texts.text: US only · history, not a forecast

graphics.what: 715 bars, one per 20-year stretch starting Jan 1947–Aug 2006, height = buying power of the 2%-a-year check after 20 raises vs its own first check (CPI-U); white line = 100% (its first check); the 17 bars at or above it in green, the rest dark. No axis numbers.
